Checked the pool for scope before writing this: `sidequest-catch-a-fish-cooking-campsite`'s own back face (Cooking Campsite) has the EXACT same cost-only-sacrifice-an-artifact shape (its own `knownGaps` already documents it as unmodeled) — this new exemption would also cover a want fact there if one gets added later, but I did NOT touch that card's synergy.json (out of scope, not asked) — flagging this back as a loose end worth the user's attention if they want parity there too.
